name: Bhel Puri
subtitle: puffed rice tossed with onion, tomato, chutneys and sev, assembled in seconds

ingredients.note: deseeded, or the bhel goes wet

prepNotes: Bhel has no cooking. It has assembly, and the entire skill is doing it fast and serving it faster.
Dry-roast the puffed rice for two minutes before you start. It is almost always slightly stale.

steps.text: Dry-roast the murmura in a wide pan over low heat for 2 minutes until it smells toasted. Cool.
steps.tip: This is what separates good bhel from cardboard.

steps.text: Blend mint, coriander and green chilli with a splash of water into a thick green chutney.
Push a stiff besan batter through a sev press into hot oil and fry until crisp, or use bought sev.
Put the murmura in a wide bowl with the onion, tomato, potato and raw mango.
Add both chutneys, the chaat masala, black salt and lemon juice, and toss hard for 10 seconds.
steps.tip: Ten seconds. Longer and the puffed rice starts to soften.

steps.text: Top with sev and coriander and serve immediately, in paper cones if you have them.

storage: Cannot be stored once mixed; it is soggy within two minutes. Keep the components separate and assemble to order.
